The Shop

A proper CBD barber, minus the CBD price tag

Kutz on King sits on King William Street on the south side of the Adelaide CBD — handy for a pre-work cut, a lunch-break tidy-up, or a Saturday morning freshen-up. The listing says "inexpensive", and the regulars keep it that way: sharp work, honest prices, in and out.

Walk-insNo appointment? Take a seat — walk-ins are the house specialty.
In & out fastMost cuts done in about 30 minutes, lunch break included.
City location352 King William St — a short walk from Victoria Square and the tram.
Early startsDoors open 8am weekdays and Saturdays for a cut before the day starts.
